comment: sp_lev.c create_door() (1714-1810) reaching impossible("create_door: Can't find a proper place!") from lspo_door()'s wall form. #wizloadlua Wiz-loca on Dlvl 1 draws its map over the level's stairs, which set_levltyp() will not overwrite, so the downstairs at <39,8> leave a gap in the west wall of the first irregular des.region(). mkmap.c flood_fill_rm() backs up through the stairs (IS_ROOM) and fills the whole moat-bounded area, so the room's bounding box has no wall a door can go in, and all 100 tries fail. Seed 8120067 was found by scanning seeds 8120001-8121500 with scripts/scan-port.mjs for a Dlvl-1 staircase at x 39, y 4-16 (14 of 1500 kept); date, human Samurai and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
